mcpUi.title: MCP servers
mcpUi.hint: Manage saved servers and current connection status. Adding a server runs a local command. Only connect services you trust.
mcpUi.readFailed: Could not read MCP servers. The list may be out of date. Retry or check your local MCP configuration.
mcpUi.builtin: Built-in service. Manage it using the Browser automation (Playwright) toggle below.
mcpUi.empty: No MCP servers added. Use the ＋ button above to add one.

mcpUi.namePrompt: Give this MCP server a display name.
mcpUi.runMessage:

mcpUi.removeFailedMessage: Disconnection or saving failed. Refresh the status and retry. The saved configuration may remain even if the connection has closed.

desktopAsr.projectLanguage: Recognition language follows your Aliyun project configuration.
desktopAsr.title: ASR settings
desktopAsr.hint: The microphone starts only when you click Dictate. Audio goes to your selected provider; transcription only fills the draft and is never sent automatically. Each recording lasts up to about 110 seconds.
desktopAsr.localUnavailable: Local recognition is not implemented. Choose another provider.
desktopAsr.mosslandHint: Audio is uploaded after stopping, then returned as complete text. Cancelling before Stop does not upload it.
desktopAsr.aliyunHint: Audio streams to Aliyun during recording. Cancellation stops sending but cannot retract audio already sent.
desktopAsr.shared: Enabled channels also use this configuration for audio transcription. Turning it off preserves saved credentials.
desktopAsr.loadFailed: Loading failed. Reopen settings and retry.

inputModalities.label: Input types
inputModalities.hint: Auto follows the input types the vendor's model list reports, then the built-in catalog; with neither, the model is treated as text only. Choose Image or Text only to override.

channels.publicHint: These settings apply to every channel.
channels.appDesc: After pairing, chat with Firefly and get reminders on your phone.

memory.heading: Firefly Memory
memory.subheading: Long-term details Firefly remembers from your chats. You can review, edit, forget them, or confirm pending items.

overview.title: Memory overview
overview.desc: Items Firefly has drafted are only remembered after you confirm them.
overview.coverageValue: {{present}} of {{population}} present, {{missing}} missing, {{unknownDenied}} unknown or denied

entries.title: My memories
entries.desc: Review what Firefly remembers. You can edit, forget, or confirm pending items.
entries.emptyAll: Nothing has been remembered yet. Firefly picks out long-term details from your chats.
entries.backendDown: The memory service is unavailable, so memories cannot be shown.
entries.loadFailed: Failed to read memories. Please retry.

obsidian.title: Obsidian sync
obsidian.desc: Writes memories as .md files into a folder you choose. Open that folder in Obsidian to explore the links between them.
obsidian.unboundHint: After you choose a folder, memories are synced there as .md files.
obsidian.exportHint: Exports to any folder without linking it.
obsidian.unboundDone: Unlinked. Existing .md files in the folder are kept.
obsidian.unavailable: Obsidian sync is not available in the current memory version.
obsidian.loadFailed: Failed to read Obsidian settings. Please retry.

imported.title: Imported knowledge
imported.desc: Documents uploaded in the chat window are indexed, and Firefly refers to them when answering.
imported.emptyHint: Upload a file in the chat window and it is indexed automatically
imported.unavailable: The imported knowledge interface is unavailable
imported.loadFailed: Failed to read imported knowledge. Please retry

enabled.title: Enable custom colors
enabled.desc: Set the accent, background and foreground colors. Changes save automatically and apply to all windows.

uiFontSize.title: Interface size
uiFontSize.desc: Base font size for the interface (12 to 20 px).

chatFontSize.title: Message font size
chatFontSize.desc: Font size of message text (12 to 22 px).

codeFontSize.title: Code font size
codeFontSize.desc: Font size of code blocks in chat and diff views (11 to 20 px).

general.heading: General
general.subheading: Choose Firefly's interface language. Changes are saved immediately.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Display language for Firefly. The chat interface applies it after Firefly restarts.

toastSound.title: Reminder sound
toastSound.desc: Plays the sound for the bottom-right popup when Firefly needs your confirmation or a task finishes.

launchAtLogin.title: Launch at login
launchAtLogin.desc: Automatically open Firefly when the system starts.

user.heading: My Info

account.signedOutDesc: Sign in to sync your profile and settings across devices (coming soon).

user.nicknameDesc: If the call preference is empty, Firefly calls you by your nickname.
user.genderDesc: Optional. If you choose Prefer not to say, Firefly does not record this.
user.callPrefDesc: Firefly uses this name first when addressing you.
user.birthdayDesc: Optional. Firefly keeps it in your personal info.
user.cityDesc: Used by location-based tools such as weather when no city is given.
user.timezoneDesc: Only used for time calculations; it does not indicate your city.
user.fieldHint: The call preference takes priority over the nickname; if both are empty, Firefly calls you Pioneer. The default city is used by location-based tools such as weather; the time zone is only used for time calculations and does not indicate your city.

nav.generalHint: Choose Firefly's interface language. Changes are saved immediately.
